Sadaat Competitor Pulse

Three moves, and what each is worth

1
Make your ad spend land

You run — Meta ads, more than any clinic in Ottawa. People who click land on a website with no prices and no client reviews. Put the prices from your ads (microneedling, PRP, facial) on the website and show your Google reviews next to the booking button. Solange in Barrhaven has 21 one- and two-star reviews among its newest 100, most about surprise prices, cancellations and rude staff, and GlowUp has the same price complaints. A clear price list wins their unhappy clients.
